Product Features

  • Modern, minimalist black and white design: The matt white cabinets in combination with black metal handles and supports impress with clean, simple lines and match various furnishing styles such as modern, minimalist and subtly luxurious. They become a visual highlight in the dining room or living room.
  • LED ambient lighting in the glass area: The central glass cabinet has adjustable LED ambient lighting that skilfully sets the scene for crockery, wine glasses and other accessories. The soft, glare-free light adds to the elegant ambience of the dining area.
  • Multi-level multifunctional storage system: Three drawers on the left side provide space for dishes, napkins and other personal items displayed in the central glass area. The closed cabinet on the right is used to store small items or spare dishes, allowing for clear categorization and meeting diverse storage needs in the dining room.
  • Sturdy and lightweight construction: The black metal supports increase the stability of the cabinets while reducing their bulk, making the overall design look lighter. Reinforced panels ensure high resilience and are suitable for long-term and frequent use.
  • Fine texture and easy care: The matte, white worktop is resistant to fingerprints and stains and is easy to clean with a wipe. The glass doors are dustproof and transparent, protecting the items on display without obstructing the view.

Descriptions

Long Description:

A central piece of furniture for any dining room, this modern, minimalist sideboard combines aesthetics and functionality. The matt white cabinets in combination with the black metal frames impress with clean, simple lines that match different interior styles. The central glass cabinet has integrated LED lighting, which perfectly sets the scene for crockery and creates an atmospheric atmosphere. Three drawers on the left and a closed cabinet on the right provide versatile storage space and meet different needs when organizing and displaying food. The sturdy metal frames ensure stability, and the matte worktop is easy to clean. The design combines practicality and elegance, making it the ideal choice for both small apartments that need more space and large homes that want to enhance their style.
